sources.summary: This year brings world-renowned choreographers, ballet cabaret and fluffy clowns for toddlers This was San Francisco Ballet’s big new commission in 2024, now getting its European premiere at Edinburgh international festival. An ambitious production with some impressive visuals, it’s a show for our times: an AI-themed retelling of the Pandora’s box myth by choreographer Aszure Barton. Music is by British producer Floating Points, who performs live, with an orchestra. Edinburgh Playhouse, 28-30 August Continue reading...
